goal: Coordinate an Idea-Spark discussion-until-gate review in default CLI-first mode. Use `hermes idea-spark call <operation> --json-file <payload>` for room operations unless explicit tool-mode has been enabled and the Hermes session reset. After room creation, report the returned room_url only after dashboard_reachable=true or another health check passes; otherwise report the dashboard_warning and room_id instead of a dead link. Join/read the room state, then launch bounded child phases outside the plugin CLI/tool handlers. Use fixed phase order: r0/seed (Seed / Framing); r1/review (Novelty Attack); r2/rebuttal (Author Rebuttal / Improvement Draft); r3/re-review (Re-review / Cross-examination); r4/gate (Gate); final/handoff. Maintain .work/idea_spark_phase_ledger.md in the project. After each nonterminal phase, call idea_spark_room_status, collect prepared file receipts and verify full artifact files, update the phase ledger with a stage checkpoint marker, re-read skill_view(name="idea-spark:idea-spark-usage"), and continue while has_terminal_gate=false. Parent must review the Gatekeeper file and call idea_spark_gate_record with close_room=true for the terminal gate. A message-only gate is not final. If evidence remains insufficient, record needs_more_evidence as the terminal gate at r4. Use idea_spark_room_export for auditability only; write any researcher-facing handoff as a detailed standalone Markdown report in the current working directory, not only under /tmp. Do not call skill_manage.
context: room_id=<ROOM_ID>; dashboard_room_url=<ROOM_URL>; idea_summary=<IDEA_SUMMARY>; payload_scratch_root=.work/delphi/<RUN_ID>/; handoff_path=idea_spark_handoffs/<RUN_ID>_handoff.md; required placeholders: <ROOM_ID>, <ROOM_URL>, <IDEA_SUMMARY>, <RUN_ID>. Use the native host contract. Before each assignment the parent calls files prepare, keeps receipt_path and passes file_path to the child. Children use native file/terminal tools, keep temporary notes in their scratch directory, write a complete report and return the absolute path; if writing fails they return the full body. After native completion the parent calls files collect, reads the complete files, records relationships and needs, and continues r1->r2->r3->r4. Parent records the actual gate and writes the standalone handoff. Optional Hermes toolsets=["terminal", "file", "skills"]; explicit tools only after config enablement and session reset. Optional Hermes explicit tool-mode uses toolsets=["idea_spark", "skills"] only after enablement and reset.
